name: Laguna Woods Village (Village Management Services)
notes: Researched from public lagunawoodsvillage.com pages (Financial Services, EZ Pay FAQ document page and its PDF revised March 2026, Contact Us). Monthly homeowner assessments (GRF + housing mutual) are billed by Village Management Services. Online: the main account holder pays by credit card in the resident portal (3.5% nonrefundable fee per transaction); statements under 'Statements'. EZ Pay auto-debit is bank only (checking/savings) and enrolment, changes and cancellation are PAPER FORMS (mail, email ezpay@vmsinc.org, Community Center payment box or Resident Services in person), deadline the 25th for next month; withdrawal on the 6th (next business day if weekend/holiday), no confirmation sent. Returned EZ Pay: pay by check or cash by the 16th to avoid a late fee (late fee amount not published - not modelled). Checks payable to Laguna Woods Village with manor number in the memo; without coupon to P.O. Box 2220, Laguna Hills, CA 92654-2220 (coupon lockbox address in Los Angeles 90074 - File 55252, Los Angeles, CA 90074-5252, confirmed by the reviewer and used). Resident Services 949-597-4600, text 888-238-4045. Open request: AutoPay enrolment by form with a pending state (dossier marks autopay unsupported online with the form route in the note). Sign-in fields not observed.

pay_online.note: The main account holder can pay assessments by credit card in the resident portal. A 3.5% nonrefundable fee applies to each transaction.

statements.note: Statements are under Statements in the resident portal; the designated account holder must log in.

autopay.note: EZ Pay is set up by form, not online: send the EZ Pay Authorization Agreement with a voided check by mail, email or the Community Center payment box, or visit Resident Services weekdays. Forms received by the 25th start next month.

autopay_cancel.note: To stop EZ Pay, send the cancellation form to the EZ Pay email, the Community Center payment box or Resident Services by the 25th to avoid the next withdrawal.

pay_by_mail.note: Mail a check payable to Laguna Woods Village with your manor number in the memo line. With your payment coupon, send it to Laguna Woods Village, File 55252, Los Angeles, CA 90074-5252; without a coupon, send it to Attn: Manor Payments, P.O. Box 2220, Laguna Hills, CA 92654-2220.

help.title: EZ Pay automatic payments
paragraphs: EZ Pay withdraws your monthly assessment from a checking or savings account on the 6th of each month (the next business day if the 6th is a weekend or holiday). It adjusts automatically to the new assessment each January. Credit cards cannot be used for EZ Pay.

Enroll or change your bank account with the EZ Pay Authorization Agreement Form from Financial Services, or at Resident Services on weekdays with a voided check (a bank letter or online-banking screenshot showing the bank name, your name and full account and routing numbers also works). Forms received by the 25th take effect the next month. No confirmation is sent; if nothing is withdrawn by the end of the 8th, email the EZ Pay team.

help.title: Cancelling EZ Pay
paragraphs: Complete the EZ Pay cancellation form and email it to the EZ Pay team, drop it in the Community Center payment box or bring it to Resident Services on weekdays. It must be received by the 25th to stop the next month's withdrawal; otherwise ask your bank to stop that payment. EZ Pay ends automatically when your unit closes escrow.

help.title: Paying your monthly assessment
paragraphs: The main account holder can log in to the resident portal and pay by credit card; a 3.5% nonrefundable fee applies to each transaction. Statements are under Statements in the portal. You can also mail a check payable to Laguna Woods Village with your manor number in the memo line. With your payment coupon, mail it to Laguna Woods Village, File 55252, Los Angeles, CA 90074-5252. Without a coupon, mail it to Laguna Woods Village, Attn: Manor Payments, P.O. Box 2220, Laguna Hills, CA 92654-2220.

help.title: If an EZ Pay withdrawal is returned
paragraphs: If a withdrawal is returned for insufficient funds, a closed account or another reason, pay by check or cash by the 16th of the month to avoid a late fee. For urgent help email the EZ Pay team.

help.title: Contact Resident Services
paragraphs: Call Resident Services at 949-597-4600 or text 888-238-4045 for help with billing, maintenance requests, amenities and community services. Security is available 24/7 at 949-580-1400.
